card.name: Modifiers before food and supplement nouns
card.fires_on: Words that qualify a food or supplement category, such as "high" before protein vegetables, "-rich" or "-containing" after a mineral, and "certain" before fruits. Mostly in lists of foods or products that interact with a drug.

modes.label: Mineral-rich or -containing
modes.description: The hyphenated ending after a mineral name, introducing foods or salts.

modes.label: Adjective before food group
modes.description: An adjective or quantifier that leads into a type of food.
modes.example: Soybeans, quinoa (a grain), and spinach are some examples of<< high>> protein vegetables.

modes.label: Binder and example lists
modes.description: Endings or list cues inside lists of examples, such as phosphate binders or "Examples of".
